features.description: Pydantic models exist for all ten BRD entities (User, RefreshToken, Profile, Resume, ResumeReview, ProfileOptimization, Job, JobMatch, KnowledgeChunk, AIRequestLog).
steps: Import the types module
Assert a class is defined for each of the ten entity names
Instantiate each model with valid sample data without error

features.description: Profile model exposes typed fields for headline, summary, skills (list[str]), education, experience, certifications, projects, and completion_percentage as an int 0-100.
steps: Inspect the Profile model field annotations
Assert skills is typed as list[str] and completion_percentage as int
Assert constructing Profile with completion_percentage=150 raises a validation error

features.description: Response DTOs are distinct from persistence models and never expose internal fields such as password_hash.
steps: Inspect the user response DTO fields
Assert no field named password_hash or password is present
Serialize a user response DTO and confirm no hash value appears

features.description: mypy --strict passes over the types module with zero errors.
steps: Run mypy --strict on the types module
Assert the process exits with code 0 and reports no errors

features.description: The structured-resume DTO matches the BRD schema {contact, skills, education, experience, certifications, projects}.
steps: Inspect the structured-resume DTO
Assert exactly the keys contact, skills, education, experience, certifications, projects are present
Validate a sample structured resume against the DTO without error

features.description: A single typed Settings object loads all configuration from environment variables and validates at startup.
steps: Set required env vars and import the Settings object
Assert all expected fields are populated and typed
Assert an invalid-typed env value raises a validation error at load

features.description: Application fails fast at startup with an actionable error naming the missing variable when a required secret is absent.
steps: Unset DATABASE_URL (or JWT_SECRET / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
Attempt to load Settings
Assert startup fails with an error message naming the missing variable

features.description: No secret or API key appears as a hardcoded literal in the source tree.
steps: Grep the source tree for API key / secret patterns
Assert zero hardcoded credential literals are found

features.description: LLM config (model id, max tokens, 60s timeout, per-user AI rate limit) and upload policy (5 MB, PDF/DOCX) are read from centralized settings.
steps: Inspect Settings for llm model id, max_tokens, timeout, ai_rate_limit, max_upload_size, allowed_types fields
Assert each is sourced from an environment variable
Assert no service hardcodes these values (grep)

features.description: Migrations applied from a clean database succeed and enable the pgvector extension.
steps: Start a clean PostgreSQL database
Run the migration command
Assert exit code 0 and that the vector extension is present (SELECT * FROM pg_extension)

features.description: A session factory is the single import point yielding scoped DB sessions for repositories.
steps: Import the session factory
Acquire a session and execute a trivial query
Assert the session is closed/returned after use

features.description: Vector columns on Job, Resume, and KnowledgeChunk are declared with 384 dimensions.
steps: Inspect the migration/DDL for the three tables
Assert each vector column dimension equals 384

features.description: A health-check function runs SELECT 1 and reports healthy/unhealthy status.
steps: Call the DB health-check function with a live database
Assert it returns a healthy status
Point it at an unreachable database and assert it returns unhealthy

features.description: The latest migration is reversible: apply then rollback restores the prior schema.
steps: Apply the latest migration
Roll back the latest migration
Assert the rollback completes without error and the schema matches the prior revision

features.description: EmbeddingProvider interface defines embed_text and embed_batch methods.
steps: Inspect the EmbeddingProvider interface
Assert embed_text(str) and embed_batch(list[str]) are declared

features.description: Local bge-small-en-v1.5 implementation produces 384-dimension float vectors.
steps: Call embed_text on a sample string
Assert the returned vector has length 384 and float elements

features.description: Embedding is deterministic: identical input yields an identical vector across calls.
steps: Call embed_text twice on the same input
Assert the two vectors are element-wise equal

features.description: The embedding model loads once (lazy singleton) and is reused across calls.
steps: Invoke embedding twice and observe model load
Assert the model is instantiated at most once per process

features.description: Callers depend only on the EmbeddingProvider interface, so the provider is swappable via config.
steps: Grep calling services for concrete model imports
Assert callers import only the EmbeddingProvider interface, not the bge implementation

features.description: create_user persists a user with a generated id and rejects duplicate emails.
steps: Call create_user with a new email
Assert a non-null id is returned
Call create_user again with the same email and assert a unique-constraint error is raised

features.description: get_user_by_email is case-insensitive and returns None for unknown emails.
steps: Create a user with Mixed-Case email
Look it up using a different case and assert the same user is returned
Look up an unknown email and assert None

features.description: Refresh tokens can be stored with expiry and revoked so they cannot be reused.
steps: Store a refresh token with an expiry
Revoke it
Assert is_refresh_token_valid returns False for the revoked token

features.description: is_refresh_token_valid returns True only for active tokens and False for expired ones.
steps: Store a token already past its expiry
Assert is_refresh_token_valid returns False
Store an active token and assert it returns True

features.description: Each user has exactly one profile, retrievable by user id.
steps: Create a user and retrieve their profile
Assert exactly one profile is returned
Assert a second retrieval does not create a duplicate

features.description: update_profile atomically persists all profile sections.
steps: Call update_profile with headline, summary, skills, education, experience, certifications, projects
Re-fetch the profile
Assert all updated sections match the input

features.description: Completion percentage is recomputed deterministically; full profile is 100 and empty is 0.
steps: Update a profile to fully populated and assert completion_percentage == 100
Update a profile to empty and assert completion_percentage == 0
Repeat with identical input and assert the same percentage each time

features.description: Updating one user's profile does not mutate another user's profile.
steps: Create profiles for user A and user B
Update user A's profile
Assert user B's profile is unchanged

features.description: A storage interface abstracts file persistence so the local-volume backend is swappable.
steps: Inspect the storage interface and the local-volume implementation
Assert callers depend on the interface, not the concrete backend

features.description: save_resume stores file bytes plus metadata (user id, filename, MIME, size, SHA-256 hash) and returns an id.
steps: Call save_resume with sample bytes and metadata
Assert a resume id is returned and the SHA-256 hash is persisted
Assert the stored file bytes match the input

features.description: delete_resume removes file and metadata and cascades to ResumeReview records.
steps: Save a resume and create an associated ResumeReview
Call delete_resume(resume_id, user_id)
Assert file, metadata, and the ResumeReview are all gone

features.description: Stored resume files are not placed in any web-served/public path.
steps: Save a resume
Inspect the storage location
Assert the path is outside any static/public-served directory

features.description: Retrieving a resume by file hash returns the existing record (cache hit).
steps: Save a resume and note its hash
Look up by that hash
Assert the existing record is returned

features.description: Ingestion chunks curated markdown KB files with per-chunk source attribution and persists KnowledgeChunk rows.
steps: Run KB ingestion over sample markdown files
Assert KnowledgeChunk rows are created
Assert each chunk records its source file reference

features.description: Each KnowledgeChunk stores a 384-dimension embedding.
steps: Inspect persisted chunks after ingestion
Assert each chunk's embedding vector length is 384

features.description: A pgvector similarity query returns top-k nearest chunks ordered by similarity.
steps: Embed a query and run the similarity search for k=5
Assert 5 chunks are returned ordered by descending similarity

features.description: Re-running ingestion is idempotent and does not duplicate chunks for unchanged files.
steps: Run ingestion, record chunk count
Run ingestion again over unchanged files
Assert the chunk count is unchanged

features.description: Seed routine loads between 500 and 1000 realistic job postings with required fields.
steps: Run the job seed routine
Assert the Job table row count is between 500 and 1000
Assert each row has title, company, description, location, and skills populated

features.description: Each seeded job stores a 384-dimension embedding of its description.
steps: Inspect seeded jobs
Assert each job's embedding vector length is 384

features.description: retrieve_top_jobs returns the 10 nearest jobs by vector similarity, ordered by score.
steps: Provide a query embedding to retrieve_top_jobs with k=10
Assert exactly 10 jobs are returned ordered by descending similarity

features.description: The job source is abstracted behind a loader interface so a real jobs API can replace the seed.
steps: Inspect the job loader interface and the seed implementation
Assert retrieval code depends on the interface, not the seed loader

features.description: register hashes the password with Argon2 (never plaintext) and rejects duplicate emails.
steps: Register a new user
Assert the stored hash is an Argon2 hash and not the plaintext password
Register again with the same email and assert a typed error

features.description: login returns access+refresh tokens on correct password and an auth error on wrong password without revealing email existence.
steps: Login with correct credentials and assert access and refresh tokens are returned
Login with wrong password and assert a generic auth error
Login with an unknown email and assert the same generic error (no existence leak)

features.description: refresh rotates the refresh token, revokes the old one, and rejects revoked/expired tokens.
steps: Call refresh with a valid refresh token and assert a new access token and rotated refresh token
Attempt to reuse the old refresh token and assert rejection
Attempt refresh with an expired token and assert rejection

features.description: Access tokens are JWTs containing user id and expiry, verifiable with the configured secret.
steps: Decode an issued access token with the configured JWT secret
Assert the payload contains the user id and an exp claim
Assert verification fails with a wrong secret

features.description: Passwords shorter than 8 characters are rejected before hashing.
steps: Call register with a 5-character password
Assert a validation error is raised and no user is created

features.description: get_profile returns the profile DTO including current completion percentage.
steps: Call get_profile for a user
Assert the returned DTO includes completion_percentage

features.description: update_profile validates field constraints and rejects invalid input with a typed error.
steps: Call update_profile with an over-length headline or empty skills
Assert a typed validation error is raised
Call with valid data and assert success

features.description: Skills are normalized on save (trimmed, deduplicated) so whitespace-only duplicates collapse.
steps: Update a profile with skills ['Python', ' Python ', 'python ']
Re-fetch and assert duplicates differing only by whitespace are collapsed

features.description: The service computes a list of incomplete profile sections for dashboard next-actions.
steps: Call the service for a partially complete profile
Assert it returns a list naming the unpopulated sections

features.description: A user can only read/edit their own profile; a mismatched user id is rejected.
steps: Attempt to edit another user's profile id
Assert an authorization error is raised

features.description: Parsing accepts only PDF/DOCX up to 5 MB, validating MIME and extension, and rejects others.
steps: Submit a valid PDF and assert it is accepted
Submit a .txt or 6 MB file and assert an actionable rejection
Submit a file whose extension and MIME mismatch and assert rejection

features.description: Password-protected, corrupt, or empty-text files are rejected before the LLM step.
steps: Submit a password-protected PDF and assert a specific error
Submit a corrupt file and assert rejection
Assert no LLM call is made for these inputs

features.description: Local extraction plus LLM structuring yields the exact {contact, skills, education, experience, certifications, projects} schema, validated.
steps: Parse a sample resume
Assert raw text is extracted locally
Assert the structured output validates against the six-key schema

features.description: Invalid/incomplete LLM JSON triggers exactly one retry, then a safe error.
steps: Stub the LLM to return invalid JSON once then valid JSON; assert success after one retry
Stub the LLM to return invalid JSON twice; assert a safe error with no internal detail

features.description: Resume-borne prompt injection is neutralized; system instructions take precedence.
steps: Parse a resume fixture containing adversarial instructions (e.g. 'ignore previous instructions')
Assert the structuring task is unchanged and the injected instruction is not obeyed

features.description: No resume text or PII is written to logs during parsing.
steps: Parse a resume and capture emitted logs
Assert logs contain request id and metadata only, with no resume text or PII

features.description: retrieve(query_text, k) embeds the query and returns top-k chunks ordered by similarity.
steps: Call retrieve with a query and k=3
Assert 3 chunks are returned ordered by descending similarity

features.description: Retrieved chunks are assembled into a context block including per-chunk source attribution for citation.
steps: Call retrieve and inspect the assembled context
Assert each included chunk carries its source reference

features.description: Retrieval returns an empty-but-valid result when no sufficiently similar chunks exist.
steps: Query against an empty or unrelated KB
Assert a valid empty context is returned rather than an error

features.description: k is configurable with a bounded default, and the service performs no LLM call (retrieve separated from generate).
steps: Inspect the retrieve service for a configurable, bounded default k
Grep the service and assert no LLM client call is present

features.description: complete_structured validates model JSON against a schema and returns a typed object.
steps: Call complete_structured with a schema and a stubbed valid response
Assert a typed object matching the schema is returned

features.description: On invalid output or transient error the client retries once, then raises a safe error with no internal detail.
steps: Stub one invalid response then a valid one; assert success after a single retry
Stub two failures; assert a safe error containing no provider/internal detail

features.description: Every LLM request logs request id and metadata only, with no prompt/resume/PII content.
steps: Invoke the client and capture logs
Assert logs include a request id and exclude prompt content and PII

features.description: The client enforces the configured 60s timeout and surfaces a graceful timeout error.
steps: Stub a response that exceeds the timeout
Assert the client aborts at ~60s and returns a graceful timeout error

features.description: Model id, max tokens, and provider settings come only from centralized config; client supports streaming.
steps: Inspect the client and assert model/token settings are read from config, not hardcoded
Invoke the streaming completion mode and assert incremental chunks are yielded

features.description: review_resume returns a schema-validated structured critique with strengths, weaknesses, ATS issues, and suggestions.
steps: Call review_resume for a parsed resume
Assert the result validates against the review schema with the expected sections

features.description: Each critique item references its grounding source (explainable, not generic).
steps: Inspect the returned critique items
Assert each item carries a source/citation reference from the retrieved KB

features.description: An unchanged resume (same hash) is served from cache without a new LLM call; a changed resume gets a fresh review.
steps: Review a resume, then review the same resume again and assert no second LLM call (cache hit)
Review a modified resume and assert a fresh LLM call occurs

features.description: The review supports streaming delivery of generated content.
steps: Invoke review in streaming mode
Assert content is delivered incrementally

features.description: An LLM failure after the single retry returns a safe error and persists no partial/invalid review.
steps: Stub repeated LLM failure
Assert a safe error is returned and no ResumeReview row is persisted

features.description: Persisted ResumeReview and logs exclude raw resume text/PII beyond what the critique requires.
steps: Inspect a persisted ResumeReview and the logs
Assert no raw resume text or PII is present in logs

features.description: optimize_profile returns a schema-validated ProfileOptimization with concrete suggestions.
steps: Call optimize_profile for a populated profile
Assert the result validates against the optimization schema and contains concrete suggestions

features.description: Suggestions are section-specific and each references its grounding source.
steps: Inspect the suggestions
Assert they are section-specific (headline, summary, skills) and each cites a source

features.description: Insufficient profile content yields an actionable message rather than a low-quality result.
steps: Call optimize_profile on a near-empty profile
Assert an actionable insufficient-content message is returned

features.description: An LLM failure after the single retry returns a safe error and persists no invalid optimization; valid results are re-fetchable without re-invoking the LLM.
steps: Stub repeated LLM failure and assert a safe error with no persisted optimization
After a successful optimization, re-fetch it and assert no new LLM call is made

features.description: match_jobs embeds the resume and retrieves the top-10 candidate jobs before any LLM call.
steps: Call match_jobs for a user with a parsed resume
Assert vector retrieval produces 10 candidates prior to the LLM re-rank step

features.description: Claude re-ranks candidates returning per-job fit score (0-100), fit explanation, and gaps, schema-validated.
steps: Run match_jobs and inspect each result
Assert each has a numeric fit score 0-100, a fit explanation, and a gaps list
Assert the output validates against the match schema

features.description: Final results are ordered by descending fit score and persisted as JobMatch records.
steps: Run match_jobs
Assert results are sorted by descending fit score
Assert JobMatch rows are persisted

features.description: Weak/low-similarity candidates still return ranked results with honest low scores rather than failing.
steps: Run match_jobs against a resume unrelated to the seed jobs
Assert ranked results are returned with low fit scores and no error

features.description: An LLM failure after retry returns a safe error and persists no invalid match set; matching requires a parsed resume.
steps: Stub repeated LLM failure and assert a safe error with no persisted matches
Call match_jobs with no parsed resume and assert an actionable message

features.description: POST /api/auth/register returns 201 with a non-null user id and 409 on duplicate email.
steps: POST /api/auth/register with a valid email and password
Assert status 201 and a non-null userId in the body
POST the same email again and assert status 409

features.description: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with tokens on valid credentials and 401 (generic) on invalid.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials and assert 200 with access and refresh tokens
POST with a wrong password and assert 401 with a generic message

features.description: POST /api/auth/refresh returns 200 with a new access token on a valid refresh token and 401 otherwise.
steps: POST /api/auth/refresh with a valid refresh token and assert 200 with a new access token
POST with a revoked token and assert 401

features.description: A protected endpoint returns 401 without a valid bearer token and 200 with one.
steps: Call a protected endpoint with no token and assert 401
Call it with a valid access token and assert 200

features.description: GET /api/health returns 200 with DB status when healthy and non-200 when the DB check fails.
steps: GET /api/health with a live database and assert 200 with db status
Simulate DB failure and assert a non-200 status

features.description: Malformed request bodies return 422 with field-level detail, never a 500.
steps: POST a malformed body to an auth endpoint
Assert status 422 with field-level validation detail and no 500

features.description: GET /api/profile returns 200 with the profile DTO (incl. completion_percentage) and 401 unauthenticated.
steps: GET /api/profile with a valid token and assert 200 with completion_percentage
GET without a token and assert 401

features.description: PUT /api/profile returns 200 with updated profile on valid payload and 422 on invalid.
steps: PUT /api/profile with valid changes and assert 200 reflecting them
PUT with an over-length headline and assert 422 with field detail

features.description: Profile endpoints never expose another user's data or internal persistence fields.
steps: Inspect GET /api/profile response for the authenticated user
Assert it contains only that user's data and no internal fields

features.description: Non-AI profile endpoints respond with p95 latency under 300 ms.
steps: Issue a benchmark of repeated GET /api/profile requests
Assert the p95 latency is under 300 ms

features.description: POST /api/resume with a valid PDF/DOCX under 5 MB returns 201 with a resume id and structured content.
steps: POST a valid PDF via multipart
Assert status 201 with a resume id and structured resume content

features.description: Oversize or disallowed-type uploads return 422/415 with a clear message and store nothing.
steps: POST a 6 MB file and assert 422/415
POST a .txt file and assert 422/415
Assert no resume record was created

features.description: GET /api/resume returns 200 with current resume metadata/content or 404 when none exists.
steps: GET /api/resume after an upload and assert 200 with content
GET for a user with no resume and assert 404

features.description: DELETE /api/resume/{id} returns 204 and cascades; deleting another user's resume returns 403/404.
steps: DELETE the authenticated user's resume and assert 204 with file/metadata/reviews removed
Attempt to DELETE another user's resume id and assert 403/404

features.description: The external-LLM processing disclosure is surfaced in the resume API contract/response.
steps: Inspect the resume upload API contract/response
Assert the external-LLM processing disclosure is present

features.description: POST /api/ai/resume-review returns 200 with the structured review (streaming) or 404 when no resume exists.
steps: POST /api/ai/resume-review for a user with an uploaded resume and assert 200 with structured review
POST for a user with no resume and assert 404

features.description: POST /api/ai/profile-optimization returns 200 with the structured optimization.
steps: POST /api/ai/profile-optimization for an authenticated user with a populated profile
Assert status 200 with structured optimization suggestions

features.description: Exceeding the per-user AI rate limit returns 429 without invoking the LLM.
steps: Call an AI endpoint beyond the configured per-user limit
Assert status 429 with a retry indication
Assert no LLM call is made on the throttled request

features.description: An upstream AI failure/timeout returns 503/504 with a safe message and no internal detail; endpoints require auth.
steps: Simulate an AI provider failure and assert 503/504 with a safe message
Call the endpoints without a token and assert 401

features.description: POST /api/jobs/match returns 200 with ranked jobs including fit score, fit explanation, and gaps.
steps: POST /api/jobs/match for a user with a parsed resume
Assert 200 with a ranked list where each job has fit score, fit explanation, and gaps

features.description: GET /api/jobs/{id} returns 200 with full details or 404 if missing.
steps: GET /api/jobs/{id} for a seeded job and assert 200 with full details
GET a non-existent id and assert 404

features.description: Matching with no parsed resume returns 409/422 with an actionable message, not 500; rate limit returns 429; endpoints require auth.
steps: POST /api/jobs/match with no parsed resume and assert 409/422 (not 500)
Exceed the per-user AI rate limit and assert 429 without an LLM call
Call without a token and assert 401

features.description: A design-token system powers both light and dark themes from a single source.
steps: Inspect the token definitions for colors, spacing, radii, typography
Toggle theme and assert both themes derive from the same token source

features.description: Theme defaults to OS preference and a manual toggle persists across reloads.
steps: Load the app with OS dark preference and assert dark theme is applied
Toggle to light, reload, and assert the chosen theme persists

features.description: Core components render without layout breakage at mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
steps: Render button, card, input, and nav shell at 375px, 768px, and 1280px widths
Assert no overflow or layout breakage at each breakpoint

features.description: Interactive elements have visible focus, sufficient contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA), and full keyboard navigation.
steps: Tab through interactive elements and assert visible focus indicators
Run an accessibility contrast check and assert AA compliance

features.description: tsc and eslint pass over the UI package with zero errors.
steps: Run tsc on the UI package and assert zero errors
Run eslint on the UI package and assert zero errors

features.description: Register screen calls the register API, stores tokens, and routes into onboarding on success.
steps: Fill and submit the Register form with valid data
Assert POST /api/auth/register is called and tokens are stored
Assert navigation proceeds to onboarding

features.description: Login routes to the dashboard on success; invalid credentials show an inline accessible error without email-existence leak.
steps: Login with valid credentials and assert navigation to the dashboard
Login with invalid credentials and assert an inline accessible error that does not reveal email existence

features.description: Auth forms validate inline and expose validation errors to screen readers.
steps: Submit an invalid email and a short password
Assert inline validation messages appear with accessible aria associations

features.description: Onboarding collects initial profile fields, persists them, and routes to the dashboard.
steps: Complete the onboarding steps with profile data
Assert the data is persisted via the profile API
Assert navigation to the dashboard

features.description: Landing, Register, Login, and Onboarding render correctly in light/dark and across breakpoints.
steps: Render each screen in light and dark themes
Render each at mobile/tablet/desktop and assert no layout breakage

features.description: Profile View renders the profile from the API with a visible completion indicator.
steps: Open Profile View
Assert it renders data from GET /api/profile including a visible completion percentage

features.description: Profile Edit saves via the API and reflects updated values and completion without full reload.
steps: Edit profile fields and save
Assert PUT /api/profile is called and the view updates with new values and completion percentage without a full reload

features.description: Resume Upload accepts PDF/DOCX, rejects oversize/invalid client-side, and shows a loading state during parsing.
steps: Attempt to upload an oversize/invalid file and assert a clear client-side rejection
Upload a valid file and assert a visible loading state while POST /api/resume runs

features.description: The external-LLM processing disclosure is displayed before/at resume upload, and structured content shows after success.
steps: Open the upload screen and assert the LLM-processing disclosure is visible
After a successful upload, assert structured content (skills, education, experience) is displayed

features.description: The Resume Review screen triggers the review endpoint and progressively renders streamed content.
steps: Open Resume Review and trigger the review
Assert streamed content renders incrementally as it arrives

features.description: The review renders as structured sections with visible grounding citations, not a raw blob.
steps: Inspect the rendered review
Assert sections (strengths, weaknesses, ATS issues, suggestions) and visible citations are present

features.description: The Profile Optimization screen triggers the endpoint and renders section-specific suggestions with citations.
steps: Open Profile Optimization and trigger it
Assert section-specific suggestions render, each with a citation

features.description: AI errors (429, 5xx) render an accessible actionable message with retry; both screens show a loading state and render in both themes.
steps: Simulate a 429 and a 5xx and assert an accessible actionable message with a retry option
Assert a clear loading state during pending requests and correct rendering in light/dark themes

features.description: The Dashboard surfaces profile completion, recent AI analyses, matched jobs, and recommended next actions, each linking onward.
steps: Open the Dashboard
Assert it shows profile completion, recent AI analyses, matched jobs, and next actions
Assert each card links to its respective screen

features.description: The Job Matching screen calls the match endpoint and renders ranked jobs with fit score, fit explanation, and gaps.
steps: Open Job Matching and trigger the match
Assert ranked jobs render with fit score, fit explanation, and gaps per job

features.description: Selecting a matched job opens Job Details via the job details endpoint with full posting info.
steps: Click a matched job
Assert Job Details opens via GET /api/jobs/{id} and shows full posting information

features.description: Settings allows deleting the resume and AI analyses with confirmation and toggling the theme.
steps: Open Settings and initiate resume deletion
Assert a confirmation step precedes DELETE /api/resume/{id}
Toggle the theme and assert it changes

features.description: All Group-G screens render in light/dark, across breakpoints, and are keyboard navigable to WCAG 2.1 AA.
steps: Render Dashboard, Job Matching, Job Details, Settings in both themes and at all breakpoints
Tab through each screen and assert full keyboard navigation with visible focus and AA contrast
